columns.name: avg_num_papers_published
columns.description: The average number of papers published in the conference per year.

columns.name: num_paper_presented_in_2012
columns.description: The number of papers presented in the conference in 2012, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: year_published_most_paper
columns.description: The year in which the most papers were published in the conference,  with ties broken by the ascending order of the year.

columns.name: per_papers_have_keyword_cancer
columns.description: The percentage of papers that have the keyword "cancer" (case insensitive) in the conference.

columns.name: total_number_paper_during_1990_to_2000
columns.description: The total number of papers published in the conference during 1990 to 2000, replace NULL values with 0.
